title: Vira Health Launches Global Employee Health Benefits Platform Covering Fertility Through Menopause | Femtech Insider
description: Vira Health, the company behind specialist menopause care provider Stella, has launched the Vira Health Member Zone - a global employee health benefits platform available in more than 100 countries and 20 languages, covering hormonal health, fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, parenting, menopause, ..
